Maharashtra Agriculture CAP Round 1 Allotments Announced

The first round of Maharashtra's Agriculture Common Admission Process (CAP) for undergraduate courses has concluded, with 10,871 students receiving course allotments. Of these, 3,147 students secured their first-choice program. The allotment results were released on the official portal agri2026.mahacet.org.
